title: Mr. Robot - SAO++ edition
notes: Power: the switch common is the 3.3 V rail (XIAO 3V3 pin and the sounder driver). Position 1 = badge 3.3 V feeds the rail. Position 2 (OFF) ties D1 to the rail through R4; position 3 (USB-BAT) leaves the badge disconnected.
On USB-BAT the XIAO powers the rail itself, from USB-C or the LiPo on J2 (which it charges). Do not plug in USB with the switch on SAO while on a badge: two 3.3 V regulators would share one rail.

Sounder driver (replaces the maker's amplifier): D10 -> R1 1.3k -> Q1 base. Q1 switches the sounder's minus side to ground. R5 || R6 (2 x 330 = 165 ohm) from 3.3 V limit the current to 19 mA whatever the sounder is.
D1 (flyback) catches the coil's kick if the sounder is magnetic; R7 1.3k discharges it if it is a piezo. Both are harmless for the other type.
R2, R3: 330 ohm on the SAO GPIO pins per docs/standard.md. R4: 330 ohm in the OFF sense line. R1, R2, R4 each let one other track pass between their pads: the board is routed on the back copper only.

The maker's ATtiny85, its reset pull-up R1 4k7, C1 100 nF, the ISP pads and his amplifier (C2 22 uF, R2 2k2, BC847) are replaced by the XIAO and the driver above. Mode button = the XIAO's BOOT button.
